description: This file is a PHP template responsible for rendering an administrative editing interface for templates within a web application. It contains PHP code, embedded HTML, JavaScript, and uses a template engine to generate dynamic content for editing templates such as titles, text, types, and handling image uploads for markdown content.

methods.name: $this->layout
methods.description: Sets the layout template for the page.

methods.name: $this->section
methods.description: Starts a named section in the template.

methods.name: $this->replace
methods.description: Replaces a section in the template.

methods.name: $this->append
methods.description: Appends content to a section in the template.

methods.name: $this->html
methods.description: Generates HTML elements dynamically, e.g., select dropdown.
